results.title: Figma is rated "Poor" with 1.9 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Looking at 83 reviews, most reviewers were unhappy with their experience overall. People frequently complained about unexpected extra charges, hidden subscription costs, and concerning billing practices that made managing professional accounts extremely difficult and costly. Consumers also experienced highly frustrating performance problems, including exceptionally slow loading times, freezing whe n handling large files, and unintuitive website navigation that wasted valuable working hours. Some reviewers were happy with the core design features and found the real-time collaboration tools very efficient and effective for team projects. Several users also noted that the platform interface is generally clear, clean, and helpful for organizing daily web design work.See more [...] Sep 9, 2026

Image 37: Rated 1 out of 5 stars

## Their broken AI renders this completely useless
Used to be pretty great for a wide range of uses. Now, they are pushing the incredibly dysfunctional AI (e.g. "Create a timeline of the Byzantine empire from Constantine to the Ottoman conquest of Constantinople" created an annual calendar year?!).   
  
Can no longer access pre-set existing --MUCH MORE FUNCTIONAL-- templates. This makes working in Figma completely unproductive. You have to build everything from scratch. So why use a clunky system like this? I was very happy with the simplicity and limits of figma because the templates used to be effective and functional enough to keep flow moving.   
  
Now, this is beyond painful and totally uselss.

September 9, 2026

Unprompted review [...] And it gets worse. I was charged for a Professional subscription on my WORK account, where I never intended to purchase anything! I previously had a subscription on a completely different account, which I canceled just days after signing up. Yet somehow, I'm now dealing with unexpected charges on my work account.  
  
Why is it so easy to start paying Figma but so frustrating to stop?  
  
This is an absolutely unacceptable experience. Subscription cancellation should take ONE CLICK, not an investigation through hidden settings and endless conversations with support.  
  
I have completely lost trust in Figma's billing practices. Until they make cancellation transparent and straightforward, I strongly recommend avoiding their paid subscriptions.
